top_article.title: People: CRO switches at Wells and Barclays, further SG shake-ups, and more
top_article.summary: Senior leadership changes across banking, market risk, asset management, and financial market infrastructure. Wells Fargo names Scott Powell new Chief Risk Officer succeeding Derek Flowers; Barclays replaces retiring Matthew Stevens with Phil Beale as CRO; Societe Generale announces a major global markets overhaul including Salim Nemouchi as UK markets head, and Natasha Dadlani and Stephane Dahome as Americas equities co-heads; Blythe Masters steps down as CEO of FNZ; Citi hires Andrei Kazantsev from Goldman Sachs as global head of FX exotics; Two Sigma hires Ian Jackson as CRO; and ProShares hires Alessio de Longis as CIO.

appointments.title: Appointment: Scott Powell named Chief Risk Officer at Wells Fargo
appointments.summary: Scott Powell, member of Wells Fargo operating committee and former COO since 2019, succeeds retiring Derek Flowers as Chief Risk Officer in mid-January 2027.

appointments.title: Appointment: Phil Beale appointed Chief Risk Officer at Barclays
appointments.summary: Phil Beale returns to Barclays as Chief Risk Officer, succeeding Matthew Stevens who retired after 34 years with the bank.

appointments.position: Head of Global Markets UK & Global Head of Prime Services
appointments.title: Appointment: Salim Nemouchi appointed Head of Global Markets UK at Societe Generale
appointments.summary: Salim Nemouchi relocates to London as Head of Global Markets UK while retaining his global head of prime services mandate, succeeding Albert Loo.

appointments.position: Co-Head of Equities and Equity Derivatives Americas
appointments.title: Appointment: Natasha Dadlani named Co-Head of Equities & Equity Derivatives Americas at Societe Generale
appointments.summary: Natasha Dadlani promoted to Co-Head of Equities and Equity Derivatives Americas, based in New York alongside Stephane Dahome.

appointments.position: Co-Head of Equities and Equity Derivatives Americas
appointments.title: Appointment: Stephane Dahome named Co-Head of Equities & Equity Derivatives Americas at Societe Generale
appointments.summary: Stephane Dahome appointed Co-Head of Equities and Equity Derivatives Americas, based in New York alongside Natasha Dadlani.

appointments.title: Appointment: Tomoyuki Sasi appointed Head of Global Markets Japan at Societe Generale
appointments.summary: Tomoyuki Sasi joins SG as Head of Global Markets Japan, succeeding Marc Saffon who became Group Country Head for Japan.

appointments.position: Deputy Head of French Retail Banking, Private Banking & Insurance

appointments.summary: Benoit Grisoni appointed Deputy Head of French retail, private banking and insurance while continuing as CEO of BoursoBank.

appointments.title: Executive Move: Blythe Masters steps down as CEO of FNZ
appointments.summary: Industry veteran Blythe Masters leaves role as group CEO of FNZ; Stephen Welch assumes executive group chair duties.

appointments.position: Global Head of FX Exotics Trading

appointments.summary: Citi hires Goldman Sachs 15-year veteran Andrei Kazantsev as Global Head of FX Exotics Trading in London, reporting to Patrick Green.

appointments.title: Appointment: Ian Jackson appointed Chief Risk Officer at Two Sigma
appointments.summary: Two Sigma appoints Ian Jackson as Chief Risk Officer, succeeding retiring CRO Satish Ramakrishna.

appointments.title: Appointment: Eric Leupold appointed CEO of Eurex
appointments.summary: Eric Leupold, head of cash market at Deutsche Boerse, named CEO of Eurex, succeeding Robbert Booij who steps down at year-end.

appointments.title: Appointment: Jake Middleton appointed Chief Security Officer at OCC
appointments.summary: OCC appoints Jake Middleton as Chief Security Officer, joining from Federal Reserve Financial Services.

appointments.title: Appointment: Thomas Gstädtner confirmed as Executive Director of the EBA
appointments.summary: Former ECB division head Thomas Gstädtner confirmed as Executive Director of the European Banking Authority on a 5-year term, succeeding Francois-Louis Michaud.

appointments.title: Appointment: Robert Cheeseman appointed Head of Prime Services Asia at Marex
appointments.summary: Marex hires former HKEX and Credit Suisse MD Robert Cheeseman as Head of Prime Services Asia.

top_article.title: Managing the risks of generative AI: a framework for enterprise risk management
top_article.summary: Establishes a practical enterprise risk management (ERM) framework specifically mapping generative AI vulnerabilities onto Basel II operational risk taxonomy. Evaluates hallucination governance, model drift, prompt injection security, and data leakage controls under emerging regulatory standards from the EU AI Act and Basel Committee guidelines.

top_article.title: PRA struggles to follow Fed's FRTB modelling moves
top_article.summary: Market risk and regulatory experts analyze the divergence between US and UK implementations of the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB). While the US Fed introduced concessions making the Internal Models Approach (IMA) more viable and capital-efficient for systemic dealers, the UK PRA's stricter stance risks driving banks toward the standardized approach, skewing global competitive dynamics.

top_article.title: US rates surge sparks new wave of FX net investment hedging
top_article.summary: Explores how sustained US interest rate differentials have spurred corporate treasurers to launch a massive wave of FX net investment hedging (NIH). Multinationals are increasingly using currency forwards to shield non-dollar balance sheet equity while harvesting positive interest carry, creating record FX forward and cross-currency volumes.

top_article.title: Beyond mirror validation: the cost of ineffective challenge in model risk management
top_article.desk: Model Risk / Journal of Risk Model Validation
organisations: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
top_article.summary: Demonstrates the severe pitfalls of 'mirror validation'—where validators merely re-execute model logic and check discrimination metrics (Gini, KS, AUC) without stress-testing calibration under regime changes. Across 500 simulations of retail credit PD models, mirror validation missed an average 32% underestimation of default probability, triggering an 8.5% loan-level capital shortfall. Presents an adversarial 5-test framework implementing supervisory 'effective challenge' requirements.
